subject.title: fix(ui): new worktree sessions stay in Coding during creation

question: Should the focused deterministic session tests be accepted for this timing-sensitive Control UI change, or should a redacted live create-and-reconcile proof remain required before merge?
rationale: The patch is narrowly tested, but the visible user effect depends on a real asynchronous Gateway/UI lifecycle that the supplied mocked evidence does not demonstrate.

options.title: Require live Control UI proof
options.body: Keep the proof gate and request a redacted recording, runtime output, or diagnostic artifact showing a worktree session remains in Coding and retains its selected model through reconciliation.

options.title: Accept deterministic test-only proof
options.body: A responsible UI owner may accept the focused mocked-Gateway tests as sufficient while explicitly owning the absence of a real-runtime artifact.

recommendation.title: Require live Control UI proof
recommendation.body: Keep the proof gate and request a redacted recording, runtime output, or diagnostic artifact showing a worktree session remains in Coding and retains its selected model through reconciliation.
